name: Amayui Labyrinth Meister
original_name: 天結いラビリンスマイスター
source:
After a great adventure over the giant moving weapon  ‘Gualacuna Fortress’ Avaro finally acquires a workshop he once dreamed of, but fortress can not move on its own anymore with the magic in its core lost. One day a ghost of the fortress appear, Fia calls her "Kuna" and welcomes to the family. However, spirit is constantly worried about magic anomality on the north-eastern border. So our heroes decide to spend honeymoon investigating the source of trouble.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2021/11/vn-of-month-july-2021-fuuraiki-4.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
围绕巨型移动兵器“瓜拉库纳城砦”的大冒险结束后，阿瓦罗终于获得了梦寐以求的工房。然而，核心魔力消失，城砦再也无法自行移动。某天，城砦的精灵现身，菲娅为她取名“库娜”，欢迎她成为家人。但精灵始终担忧东北边境的魔力异常，于是，两人决定趁蜜月旅行，调查麻烦的源头。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2021/11/vn-of-month-july-2021-fuuraiki-4.html]vndbreview[/url]]
